title: Circles (Basics)
description: Learn Circles for Grade 7: radius, diameter, chord, circumference and area using pi. Includes semicircle and quarter circle formulas with solved examples.

topics.title: Radius, Diameter, Chord, Circumference, Area
topics.concept:
A circle is the set of all points equidistant from a fixed center point.

TermDefinitionFormula
Radius (r)Distance from center to edger = d / 2
Diameter (d)Distance across circle through centerd = 2r
ChordLine segment joining any two points on circle—
Circumference (C)Distance around the circleC = 2πr = πd
Area (A)Space enclosed by the circleA = πr²

Value of pi: π ≈ 3.14159... or 22/7 (approx). Use 22/7 when radius is a multiple of 7.

Semicircle: Area = πr²/2, Perimeter = πr + 2r

Quarter circle: Area = πr²/4, Perimeter = πr/2 + 2r

  O = center

  PS = chord (does not pass through center)

FORMULAS:
  Circumference = 2 * pi * r  (or pi * d)
  Area          = pi * r^2
  Semicircle area = pi*r^2 / 2
  Quarter circle area = pi*r^2 / 4

examples.problem: Circle radius = 7cm. Find diameter, circumference, area. (use pi = 22/7)
Circle circumference = 62.8cm. Find radius and area. (pi = 3.14)
Semicircle radius = 14cm. Find perimeter and area. (pi = 22/7)
examples.solution: Perimeter = pi x r + 2r = 44 + 28 = 72cm. Area = pi x r^2 / 2 = 616/2 = 308cm^2.

recap: radius (r) = half of diameter: r = d/2
Use pi = 22/7 when radius is a multiple of 7; otherwise use 3.14

questions.q: Radius = 5 cm. What is the diameter?
Find the area of a circle with radius = 14 cm (pi = 22/7).
Semicircle radius = 7 cm. Find its area. (pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Full circle area = (22/7) x 49 = 154 cm^2. Semicircle = 154/2 = 77 cm^2.

options: A line joining any two points on the circle
questions.explanation: A chord connects any two points on the circle. If it passes through the center, it is a diameter.

questions.q: Circle area = 78.5 cm^2 (pi = 3.14). Find the radius.
Quarter circle has radius = 8 cm. Find its perimeter. (pi = 3.14)
questions.explanation: Arc = (pi x r)/2 = (3.14 x 8)/2 = 12.56 cm. Plus 2 straight sides = 2 x 8 = 16 cm. Total = 28.56 cm.

questions.q: Wheel radius = 35 cm. Distance covered in 10 rotations? (pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 x (22/7) x 35 = 220 cm. For 10 rotations: 220 x 10 = 2200 cm.

questions.q: Two circles have radii 3 cm and 6 cm. What is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation: Area is proportional to r^2. Ratio = 3^2 : 6^2 = 9 : 36 = 1:4.

questions.q: A circular garden (radius=14m) has a 3.5m wide path outside it. Find the area of the path. (pi=22/7)
A wire bent into a circle has area 154 cm^2. The same wire is bent into a square. Find the square's area. (pi=22/7)
questions.explanation: pi*r^2=154 => r=7cm. Circumference=44cm. Square side=44/4=11cm. Area=11^2=121cm^2.

questions.q: A semicircle sits on top of a rectangle (width=14cm, height=10cm). Find the total perimeter. (pi=22/7)
questions.explanation: Perimeter = two heights + base + semicircle arc = 10+10+14+(22/7*7) = 34+22 = 56 cm.

questions.q: A circular track has inner radius 35m and outer radius 42m. Find the area of the track. (pi=22/7)
A pizza of radius 12 cm is cut into 8 equal slices. Find the area of one slice. (pi=3.14)
The minute hand of a clock is 10.5 cm long. How far does the tip travel in 45 minutes? (pi=22/7)
questions.explanation: 45 min = 3/4 of full rotation. Distance = (3/4) x 2 x (22/7) x 10.5 = (3/4) x 66 = 49.5 cm.
